name: Amplifier
description: Microsoft's modular AI development assistant CLI, an early research preview assembled from swappable bundles.
whatItDoes: Amplifier answers questions and performs development work from the terminal, in one-shot or chat mode. Microsoft describes it as an experimental demonstrator without safety systems yet, to be used with supervision.
howItWorks: A small core loads bundles that supply providers, tools and behaviours, so capabilities can be added or replaced. A first-run wizard configures the model provider.

requirements.name: LLM provider credentials
requirements.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI key, or a local Ollama
